verdict.rationale: Loops documents ways to test before going live: testing transactional email and your integration from the CLI, creating draft campaigns via the API for review in the dashboard, and running Guardian checks on messages. None of this is shown to run in an isolated sandbox, so it only glancingly supports testing without touching production data. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or test-mode environment, test API keys or a separate workspace isolated from production contacts and sends, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
